model.required: Player.forever_revelation_model.enabled=true when8217 equipped or in an enabled item swap; no hidden proc chance
model.conditionalChance: baseChance * (1 - clamp(effective eligible event crit chance,0,1))^critExponent
model.validation: finite baseChance in[0,1]; finite critExponent>=0; explicit zero valid
model.eligible: noncritical direct damage/healing owner events matched to the class payload; miss events only when triggerOnMiss=true
model.exponentZero: flat conditional probability; noncritical eligibility already reduces overall proc frequency as crit increases
model.effectiveCrit: pre-Revelation event chance, including spell-specific, school/target crit or physical attack-table suppression; captured by the actual crit helper when it rolls
model.samplingConvention: provisional per calculated eligible logical direct event, not a decoded next-spell/all-targets server rule
model.consumptionConvention: one charge reserved/consumed at the first eligible outcome sample that actually consults the direct crit bonus, before projectile travel; channel containers, expected-damage queries, crit-incapable outcomes and misses that never roll crit preserve the charge

revelationModel.aliasesSource: 70291 parent description child-spell tokens; child Effect2 SCHOOL_DAMAGE; exact class-family/payload-mask intersection; no child has Attribute2 CANT_CRIT0x20000000. Only corresponding channeled periodic tick representations are logical direct for Revelation. Original timing, callback category, metric IDs, ordinary periodic crit and damage calculations are retained.

directLegacyAliases.ArcaneMissiles: 5143/5144/5145/8416/8417/10211/10212/25345 Tag1 direct tick spells retain their registered parent ActionID; source class mask and exact child triggers establish eligibility. Tag0 CalcOutcome channel container does not qualify.

revelationModel.excluded: ordinary DoT/HoT damage/healing and snapshots, wands/autos, non-family spells, pets and other units; no global stat crit mutation
